The privacy policy names the legal entity MemU Technologies, Inc. but gives no seat or address, and nevamind.ai carries no company details
The terms name Evermind AI, Inc. under Singapore law and the privacy policy says the services are generally provided from Singapore; neither states a headquarters
The privacy policy says the services are hosted in the United States and intended for visitors there, and the footer names Memori Labs Inc.; no headquarters or seat is stated
The MemoryOS page gives the lab's contact as baiting@bupt.edu.cn, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications; a university lab takes its university's country
